mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.thread_id AS threadId, t.seq, t.status, t.origin, t.origin_ref AS originRef, t.client_msg_id AS clientMsgId, t.run_as_json AS runAsJson, t.options_json AS optionsJson, t.step_count AS stepCount, t.recover_count AS recoverCount, t.worker_id AS workerId, t.lease_version AS leaseVersion, t.lease_until AS leaseUntil, t.error_code AS errorCode, t.error_message AS errorMessage, t.prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, t.completion_tokens AS completionTokens, t.started_at AS startedAt, t.ended_at AS endedAt, t.create_at AS createAt, t.update_at AS updateAt FROM runtime_turn t JOIN runtime_thread s ON s.id = t.thread_id WHERE t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_CHILD', 'INTERRUPTED') AND t.run_as_json::jsonb ->> 'userId' = #{userId} AND (CAST(#{workspaceId} AS VARCHAR) IS NULL OR s.workspace_id = CAST(#{workspaceId} AS VARCHAR)) LIMIT 500

mapper.select: SELECT id, thread_id AS threadId, seq, status, origin, origin_ref AS originRef, client_msg_id AS clientMsgId, run_as_json AS runAsJson, options_json AS optionsJson, step_count AS stepCount, recover_count AS recoverCount, worker_id AS workerId, lease_version AS leaseVersion, lease_until AS leaseUntil, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM runtime_turn WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY seq LIMIT 1

SELECT id, thread_id AS threadId, seq, status, origin, origin_ref AS originRef, client_msg_id AS clientMsgId, run_as_json AS runAsJson, options_json AS optionsJson, step_count AS stepCount, recover_count AS recoverCount, worker_id AS workerId, lease_version AS leaseVersion, lease_until AS leaseUntil, error_code AS errorCode, error_message AS errorMessage, prompt_tokens AS promptTokens, completion_tokens AS completionTokens, started_at AS startedAt, ended_at AS endedAt, create_at AS createAt, update_at AS updateAt FROM runtime_turn WHERE thread_id = #{threadId} AND status IN ('RUNNING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_CHILD', 'QUEUED') ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 0 WHEN 'WAITING_APPROVAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'WAITING_CHILD' THEN 2 WHEN 'QUEUED' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, seq DESC LIMIT 1
